text: Fictional ParcelDock: built ASP.NET Core REST endpoints for parcel tracking. Packaged the web services as Docker images and deployed the containers with health checks.
Fictional PantryLink: developed HTTP services in C# for grocery stock updates. Shipped the services in isolated images using a Dockerfile and an automated deployment pipeline.
Fictional SeatLedger: wrote ASP.NET Core APIs for theater bookings, including request validation and SQL transactions. Hosted the application directly on a Windows server without containers.
Fictional MapHarbor: implemented public web endpoints in Go for ferry schedules. Created Docker images and ran the services as containers with Kubernetes readiness checks.
Fictional SurveyBoard: built a React dashboard for survey charts. Used a supplied REST endpoint but did not implement the server or its deployment.
Fictional ContainerNotes: edited a glossary whose headings included experience, building, containerized, and APIs. The work was technical proofreading; no software or deployment was implemented.
Fictional NightArchive: scheduled Python scripts to copy old inventory files into cloud storage. Ran the scripts as Docker containers; the system exposed no web endpoints.
Fictional OrchardWatch: configured soil sensors and recorded readings over a serial connection. Calibrated hardware and maintained wiring diagrams.
Fictional InvoiceBridge: developed Java REST services for invoice lookup and approval. Deployed packaged services into containers and checked HTTP readiness in an automated release pipeline.
Fictional CatalogCheck: tested existing APIs using an HTTP client and documented failed requests. This project covered quality assurance rather than implementing or deploying services.
Fictional BudgetSheet: created spreadsheet formulas and pivot tables for a community garden budget. Checked totals and prepared printed monthly reports.
Fictional GalleryPocket: designed a mobile interface for browsing museum images. Cached downloaded artwork on the device and tested screen reader labels.
